name: DomainsDB.info domain search API
operator: DomainsDB.info (operator to be identified by the reviewer before any promotion)
tier_rationale: P005 cond 4: 'domainsdb_search's provider is unknown tier until reviewed' - an unknown-tier provider may receive only IOC_TYPES values (A8 BR4) and a brand keyword is not one, so the module runs only after a recorded promotion to community tier.

reliability.justification: Unreviewed registered-domain index (create/update dates and DNS records of unknown freshness); keyword hits are candidates to verify.

domainsdb.plan_hint: a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded as key_plans.domainsdb (P005 cond 3: key-terms); the provider must first be promoted from unknown tier (cond 4)

search.title: DomainsDB /v1/domains/search?domain={keyword}&zone={tld} (registered domains containing a keyword)

terms.quote: DomainsDB keyword search discloses the brand: a separate module domainsdb_search, key-terms, default_enabled=False, keywords only from org_profile brands.

search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P005 cond 3). Research C0046: anonymous access disabled since 2026 (HTTP 401 {"error":"API key required","message":"Anonymous access is disabled. Please sign in to obtain an API key ... 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' or the 'api-key' header."}). reuses_queries is set fail closed (P005 cond 4): the searched brand stays excluded at TLP:AMBER and above even after a promotion.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-1 (P005 cond 3-4, module domainsdb_search). Unknown tier until a reviewer records a promotion to community (tier_rationale/tier_reviewer/tier_date): until then the policy gate refuses keywords (A8 BR4) and the module never runs. No published quota: one request per brand, 1 s apart, 24 h cache.
